{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0501","text":"Fatima!! Forwarding this so it lands on your calender too, I wasnt sure the first one went through. SO excited to finally get some time with you, this is going to be great!!

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Will
To: Fatima Grummond
Subject: Will / Fatima catch-up :)

When: Thursday, 6:30pm - 7:00pm
Where: Bluebrook Village HOA clubhouse, small room by the mailboxes (or my porch if the clubhouse is locked again!)

Hi Fatima!!

Okay I am just thrilled you agreed to step into the treasurer role, honestly the board has been buzzing about it all week. Leon said you were the most organized person on Cypress Lane and he was NOT exagerating. I wanted to grab a half hour with just the two of us before the next board meeting so we can get you settled in and talk through a bunch of stuff.

There's a lot going on right now with the Driftwood migration (moving all the dues records off the old spreadsheets, Oskar started it and then got busy with his kitchen reno lol) so that might come up, and also maybe the reserve fund stuff, and whatever questions you have! No pressure to prep anything at all. Just bring yourself and maybe a notebook if you like notebooks, I definately do.

I'll bring coffee and those lemon bars Gemma makes, she dropped off way too many after the pool committee thing.

Can't wait!! This year is going to be our best one yet, I can feel it.

Will
Board President, Bluebrook Village HOA"},{"spec_id":"spec_0502","text":"Quick 30 with all seven of us on Tangerine? Also, lot B closed Friday, sorry."},{"spec_id":"spec_0503","text":"Subject: Project Kiln cross-team alignment (attendance appreciated this time)

Hi all,

Since the last three threads on Project Kiln didn't quite get us there, I've booked an hour Wednesday 10:00-11:00 in the 4th floor boardroom and on video [link]. I've invited Merchandising, Supply Chain, Store Ops, Marketing, Finance, and Regional leads, about 20 of us, so nobody can say they weren't looped in.

Agenda (owners, please actually come prepared):
1. Kiln launch date for the spring ceramics line: confirm or move. Gus Lefebvre, 10 min. This is the one thing we truly need to decide in the room.
2. Distribution center allocation update. Esme Esposito, 5 min (slides here [link]).
3. In-store fixture timeline. Valentina Haddad, 5 min.
4. Marketing calendar walkthrough. Rhys Nakagawa, 10 min.
5. Margin model refresh. Jada Ekwueme, 10 min (pre-read [link], which I'm sure everyone will open this time).
6. Regional rollout readiness, round robin across all regions. Paloma Uchenna to facilitate, 20 min.

I realize it's a lot of people and a lot of updates, but apparently the written updates in the shared tracker [link] aren't being read, so here we are.

If you can't attend, please send a delegate who can make decisions on your behalf, not just take notes. And if you have a conflict with the launch date, I'd honestly love to hear it before the meeting rather than after, for once.

Thanks so much,
Femi
Program Manager, Elmcrest Home Goods"},{"spec_id":"spec_0504","text":"FYI: Kestrel weekly, reshoot vs. VFX decision on Act 3 per Priya's attached agenda."},{"spec_id":"spec_0505","text":"Hearth rollout stakeholder review

Google Meet: [join link]
Organizer: Deepa
Guests (13): Ximena Brennan, Will Rasmussen, Mariam Thorne, Omar Varga, Zoe Kowalczyk, Bea Ekwueme, +7 more

Sync on Hearth rollout north-star metrics, adoption funnel and cross-functional learnings. Goal is shared context + alignment on next-phase motions. Dashboard linked in the doc."}]}
